75767.notes: Ven. Sujato: Compare RV5,030.07c atrā dāsasya namuceḥ śiro yad avartayo manave gātum icchan. 'At the time when you caused the head of the Dāsa Namuci to roll, seeking an (open) way for Manu). The coincidence of topic and phrasing is too close for coincidence, and I propose that in this case, gāmiya is a taddhita from gama + iya. 75769.notes: Apaṇṇaka appears to be a gambling term, connected with kataggāha / kaliggāha. A set of dice divisible by four was kataggāha (see Brereton, Jamison RV 10.34) a 'perfect hand'. The fifth 'losing' (kali) die was all-powerful, since just one extra die meant you lose everything (Rig Veda 10.34.2, Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 5.4.4.6). Apaṇṇaka is therefore literally a 'set without a fifth', having the metaphorical sense 'without fail'.

75786.commentary: (DNa) pātabyatan'ti sevitabbataṃ. (MNa) pātabyataṃ āpajjantī'ti te vatthukāmesu kilesakāmena pātabyataṃ pivitabbataṃ, yathāruci paribhuñjitabbataṃ āpajjantī'ti attho.

examples.text: ye kho pana, vāseṭṭha, tena samayena sattā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti, te māsam'pi dvemāsam'pi na labhanti gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisituṃ. yato kho te, vāseṭṭha, sattā tasmiṃ asaddhamme ativelaṃ pātabyataṃ āpajjiṃsu.

rājā sālīhi atthe sati āharissasi, ehi gacchāmā'ti sattatiyā hiraññakoṭīhi saddhiṃ te tayo'pi jane gāhāpetvā nagaraṃ gantvā pāsādavare mahātalaṃ āruyhaṃ dhanaṃ saṅgopetvā sappassa vasan'atthāya suvaṇṇanāḷiṃ, undūrassa phalikaguhaṃ, suvassa suvaṇṇapañjaraṃ kārāpetvā sappassa ca suvassa ca bhojan'atthāya devasikaṃ kañcanataṭṭake madhulāje, undūrassa gandhasālitaṇḍule dāpesi, dān'ādīni ca puññāni karoti.

75792.meaning1: gets back; finds again; regains; recovers
75792.commentary: (ANa) mātā'pi puttaṃ paṭilabhatī'ti āgacchantaṃ vā gacchantaṃ vā ekasmiṃ ṭhāne nilīnaṃ vā passituṃ labhati.

examples.text: gāmesu'pi ḍayhamānesu nigamesu'pi ḍayhamānesu nagaresu'pi ḍayhamānesu hoti so samayo yaṃ kadāci karahaci mātā'pi puttaṃ paṭilabhati, putto'pi mātaraṃ paṭilabhati. idaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṃ samātāputtikaṃ'y'eva bhayaṃ amātāputtikaṃ bhayanti assutavā puthujjano bhāsati.

75794.commentary: (DNa) adhimuttipadānī'ti adhivacanapadāni. atha vā bhūtaṃ atthaṃ abhibhavitvā yathāsabhāvato aggahetvā pavattanato adhimuttiyo'ti diṭṭhiyo vuccanti. adhimuttīnaṃ padāni adhimuttipadāni, diṭṭhidīpakāni vacanānī'ti attho.

examples.text: bhagavā etadavoca, santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā apar'antakappikā apar'ant'ānudiṭṭhino apar'antaṃ ārabbha anekavihitāni adhimuttipadāni abhivadanti.

75795.construction: adhi > adhy > ajjh + ā + vasa + ti
75795.commentary: (DNa) ukkaṭṭhaṃ ajjhāvasatī'ti ukkaṭṭhanāmake nagare vasati. abhibhavitvā vā āvasati. tassa nagarassa sāmiko hutvā yāya mariyādāya tattha vasitabbaṃ, tāya mariyādāya vasi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti ukkaṭṭhaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
parosahassaṃ kho pan'assa puttā ahesuṃ sūrā vīr'aṅgarūpā parasenappamaddanā. so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasi.
atha kho bhagavā udumbarikāya paribbājak'ārāme sīhanādaṃ naditvā vehāsaṃ abbhuggantvā gijjhakūṭe pabbate paccuṭṭhāsi. sandhāno pana gahapati tāva'd'eva rājagahaṃ pāvisī'ti.

no ce kira taṃ, vakkali, attā sīlato upavadati, atha kiñ'ca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāro'ti? cirapaṭik'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu'kāmo, n'atthi ca me kāyasmiṃ tāvatikā balamattā, yāvat'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkameyyan'ti.

75799.commentary: (PYt) phaḷusaṅkhātaṃ siṅgaṃ visāṇaṃ asmiṃ atthī'ti siṅgī, so'y'eva kaṭukabhayehi viramitabbattā siṅgīvero'ti vuccati.
